response.sql:
WITH invoice_stats AS (
  SELECT
    invoice_number,
    AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS average_quantity,
    SUM(derived_product_cost) AS total_product_cost,
    SUM(derived_total_cost) AS total_total_cost
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
with_overall AS (
  SELECT
    invoice_number,
    average_quantity,
    (total_product_cost - total_total_cost) / NULLIF(total_total_cost, 0) AS cost_ratio,
    AVG(average_quantity) OVER () AS overall_average_quantity
  FROM invoice_stats
)
SELECT
  invoice_number,
  average_quantity,
  cost_ratio,
  average_quantity - overall_average_quantity AS quantity_above_overall_average
FROM with_overall
WHERE average_quantity > overall_average_quantity
ORDER BY quantity_above_overall_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: product_quantity contains values convertible to DECIMAL; nonnumeric values are not treated as missing quantities.
The overall average is the unweighted average of each invoice's average quantity, including invoices whose average quantity is NULL (which AVG ignores).
